sentences.text:
Mithu Roy vs Unknown on 26 September, 2025
26.09.2025
Court No. 07
 Crr 3474 of 2025
Item No. 50

In Re: An application under Section 401 read with Section 482 of  Ab  the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section  442 read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha  Sanhita, 2023;
 and  In the matter of : Mithu Roy.

Mr. Navnil De,
 Mr. Rajeshwar Chakraborty.

1. 
The present revisional application has been preferred seeking quashing of Sessions Case No. 13 of 2025 arising out of Bagnan Police Station Case No. 30 of 2022 dated 23rd January 2022 under Sections 323/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that initially the case was registered under Sections 498A/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code against the husband and his relatives, and that the petitioner has no relation with the de facto complainant.
3. It was alleged in the First Information Report that petitioner has an extramarital affair with the husband of the de-facto complainant.

He further submits that the provisions of Section 498A cannot be applied against the petitioner, and that the ingredients of Section 306 of the Indian Penal Code are also not made out to implicate the petitioner in connection with this case.

4. Heard the learned Advocate for the petitioner and perused the materials on record.
5.

The order dated 18th June 2024 indicates that the charges under Sections 498A/323/306 of the Indian Penal Code were framed against the husband, whereas the charges under Sections 323/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code have been framed against the petitioner and other persons.
6. Taking note of the facts and circumstances of this case, I am of the view that the issue raised in the revisional application warrants consideration on merits.
An opportunity of hearing shall be afforded to all the parties in this application.
